_doc: Session-lead evaluation scores. Scores are assigned only to candidates whose evidence the lead saw directly (browser screenshots and/or raw source reads) or which carry a verified MIT/Apache licence with a fetched demo. Others remain null per the no-fabrication rule. Weights: visual .25, source .20, reuse .15, agent .15, integration .10, perf .10, resp .05.
_licence_gate: Only candidates with a verified open licence may be shortlisted. robin-dela/flowmap-effect, vaneenige/scroll-transitions-webgl, Scenes3D/particles-flow-field, akella/webGLImageTransitions are scored but licence gate FAILS (no licence / unverified).
